subject: planner: encapsulate binding operations behind 2 interfaces (#49261)
summary: Reviewed this commit vs first parent. Changes are a refactor that introduces `bindinfo.GlobalBindingHandle`/`bindinfo.SessionBindingHandle` interfaces, updates Domain to store the global handle as an interface (`atomic.Value`), and updates executor/planner/session call sites to use the new interfaces and renamed methods. No Blocker/High issues found in planner/executor/session correctness, SQL semantics, session/txn behavior, or compatibility based on the diff and minimal surrounding callers; later history scan did not indicate a follow-up fix needed for a high-severity regression from this refactor.
